articles.title: Letter: St. Brendan’s Parish Did a Good Job This Spring
body: To the editor: Please keep the Saturday cleanup day in the budget. Many of us on Quincy Place use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Quincy Place for 14 years, and I want to say what a difference St. Brendan’s Parish has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the June meeting.
Please keep the Saturday cleanup day in the budget. Many of us on Quincy Place use it every week.
Nadia Haddad, Lower Millrace

articles.title: Wanda Ingersoll, 68, Bus Driver
articles.deck: Friends remember Wanda Ingersoll for the many years of service to Tannery Flats.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Tannery Flats. Wanda Ingersoll died in April at home on Orion Lane, at the age of 68.
Born in Tannery Flats in the years after the war, Wanda Ingersoll spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group in his or her name.
